title: Customer snapshot exports: SLA tiering, staged delivery and cost guardrails
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Build a customer-facing feature to support on-demand "snapshot" exports of workspace usage and cost breakdowns with SLA tiers. The goal is to provide predictable delivery windows (near-real-time to 72h batch), explicit cost guardrails and tenant-aware delivery lanes for large customers, while keeping the intake experience self-serve and scannable by Solutions & Support teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Intake form in Console collects export schema, tenant filter, retention window, desired SLA tier, and delivery destination; 2) Three SLA tiers defined (Realtime <1h, Standard 8-24h, Bulk 24-72h) with documented cost multipliers; 3) Backend routing rules implemented to place exports into appropriate processing lanes based on tenant size and requested SLA; 4) Cost estimator surfaced in UI and as a preview before submission; 5) Audit log entries and RBAC checks for exports to external destinations; 6) E2E smoke test that verifies a Standard-tier export completes within SLA for a 50M token workspace sample.
comments: 2026-02-19 - Arjun Patel: Kickoff with Support and Solutions teams. Key asks: predictable SLAs, per-export cost estimate, and ability to restrict exports for sensitive tenants.

2026-02-23 - Engineering rep (Lina Zhao): Proposed approach — reuse existing export pipeline but add priority queue and tenant-weighted sharding. Raised concerns about peak-day spikes for Realtime tier.
2026-02-25 - PM sync: Trade-off between queuing memory pressure and customer SLAs. Agreed to cap Realtime concurrently processed exports per-region and surface backlog estimate to users.
2026-03-02 - Design review (Ritika Menon): Shared mockups for intake flow and cost preview modal. Feedback: make destination secrets upload explicit, show data residency label next to SLA selector.
2026-03-06 - Security note (Samir Khan): Must include KMS-enforced delivery for external S3 endpoints for enterprise tenants. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-09 - Engineering update (Lina Zhao): Implemented tenant classifier and queueing prototype; initial benchmarks show Standard-tier for 10M token snapshots completes in ~3.5h under staging load. Need optimization for Realtime kernel hot-paths.
2026-03-12 - Stakeholder demo: Solutions & Account execs requested an enterprise-only gated lane for compliance-sensitive tenants with manual approval requirement.
2026-03-14 - PM note (Maya Thompson): Collating feedback to finalize acceptance criteria and handoff to Eng for the first sprint. Added dependency on billing-rate-card service for cost multipliers.
decisions: Adopt three SLA tiers (Realtime / Standard / Bulk) with explicit cost multipliers rather than negotiated credits per-export
Use existing export pipeline with added priority queues and tenant-weighted sharding to minimize new infra surface
Introduce an 'enterprise gated' flag for tenants requiring manual approval and KMS-only deliveries

Implement queueing controls and per-tenant token budget in runtime (Eng) - sprint 2026-W11
Integrate billing-rate-card for cost estimate preview (Billing team) - dependency: BILL-4487
